annotation.title_clean: Development and utilization of robotic services to assist care facilities
annotation.title_en: Development and utilization of robotic services to assist care facilities
annotation.venue: Seoul Metropolitan Government English website (Smart City News)
named_instruments_referenced: Seoul Comprehensive Robotics Industry Development Plan
annotation.summary_en: Seoul Metropolitan Government news item announcing its Comprehensive Robotics Industry Development Plan (to 2026, ₩202.9 billion): a robotics investment fund, robot services in care facilities and daycare centers, and a Suseo Robotics Cluster supporting prototyping, safety design and certification.
key_provisions_or_claims: ₩202.9 billion over four years, fifteen policies through 2026
Establish a robotics-investment fund for development, field testing and commercialization
Introduce healthcare robots in long-term care facilities and storytelling/childcare robots in daycare centers
Build Suseo Robotics Cluster supporting prototype mass production, safety design and certification
Open AI & Robotics Science Museum to increase public familiarity with robots
